_readme: An example config for this trade. Copy it over engine.config.json and edit. Prices are in cents: 8900 is $89.00. A service with "due": 0 takes no payment and becomes a visit request instead. This file is served to the browser, so put nothing private in it; the inbox that receives bookings is the NOTIFY_TO environment variable, not this file.

business.name: Cedar Creek Plumbing
business.tagline: Water where it should be, and nowhere else.

copy.headline: Book a plumber.
copy.sub: Tell us what's going on, pick a time, and hold your spot. Two minutes, and nothing is charged until you confirm.
copy.depositNote: The deposit comes off your bill. If we can't make it, you get it back in full.

services.name: Leak or drip
services.blurb: Under a sink, behind a wall, a running toilet, a dripping tap.
services.label: Diagnostic visit
services.note: Covers the visit and finding the problem. Any repair is quoted before we touch it.

services.name: Clogged drain
services.blurb: A sink, shower, toilet or main line that won't clear.
services.label: Drain clearing
services.note: Paid in full up front. If it needs a camera or a dig, we quote that first.

services.name: No hot water
services.blurb: A tank or tankless heater that's cold, leaking or noisy.
services.label: Diagnostic visit
services.note: Covers the visit and the diagnosis. Repair or replacement is quoted on the spot.

services.name: Sump pump replacement
services.blurb: A new pump, fitted and tested, for a basement that must stay dry.
services.label: Sump pump, supplied and fitted
services.note: A $100 deposit holds the day; the balance is due when it's running.

services.name: Remodel or repipe
services.blurb: A bathroom, a kitchen, or the whole house. An estimate on paper, free.
services.label: Free in-home estimate
services.note: Nothing to pay now. We'll confirm the time by phone.

urgency.label: Today — it's leaking or backed up
urgency.note: Same-day and after-hours visits carry a fee, shown before you pay.
